{{Top|leg}}
A '''beralyx''' was a type of large, three-[[Limb/Legends|limbed]] [[Reptile/Legends|reptile]] with a forked tail. During the [[Republic Dark Age]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Arkadia Calimondra]] owned a beralyx on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Syned]], and in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], she rode out on the creature to greet the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] and the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Jarrow Rusher]].
